headline: Tobacco violation hearing for Circle K at 337 Appleton St.
summary: Other business includes local body art rules and how to use opioid settlement money. A community cleanup program is also up for discussion.
items: Tobacco violation hearing: Circle K (337 Appleton St.).
Overview of Board of Health responsibilities.
Presentations and discussion on local body art regulations.
Discussion on opioid settlement allocation and connecting with community partners.
Discussion on establishing the community cleanup program.
Department updates presented by Director Garelli.
